visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of a young woman with short dark hair wearing a lavender zip-up athletic shirt. She uses a transparent plastic tweezer-like tool with blue tips near her right eye. The background is a plain light-colored wall with a white door visible. (2) She pulls the tool back and looks directly into the camera with an expressive, slightly surprised facial expression. A red exclamation mark variety graphic appears above her head to emphasize the moment. (3) The scene shifts as she holds a small transparent cylindrical container with Japanese text, showcasing the contact lens applicator kit inside. Her hands are steady, and her fingernails are neatly manicured. (4) Close-up focus on her hands opening a pink and white contact lens blister pack. She uses a small light-blue plastic spoon to carefully scoop a clear contact lens out of the saline solution. (5) She transfers the lens onto the clear plastic applicator tool. The background reveals a makeup vanity area with various cosmetic containers and brushes in a tray, illuminated by soft indoor lighting. (6) The woman uses her left hand to pull her upper and lower eyelids apart while holding the tool in her right hand, slowly moving the lens toward her eye. (7) A green checkmark and 'DONE!' text overlay appears on the screen as she smiles successfully at the camera. (8) A similar process is shown for the other eye, with the camera zooming in closely to show the lens making contact with the eyeball. (9) She demonstrates removing the lens by using the same tool to gently pinch the lens surface. Variety text including 'Let's try' and 'Success' appear as graphic overlays. (10) The video concludes with her holding the tool up to the camera, pointing at it enthusiastically with a joyful smile. A red checkmark and text 'Can Buy!' appear at the bottom.
